# ScorX — The Sports Tracking App Built for the Sideline

## North Star
"Every kid who plays deserves to know they're improving."

## About
ScorX is an Australian-developed iOS sports tracking app that turns every game into a development story. Designed for community sport families and coaches in Australia and New Zealand, ScorX makes the invisible process of athletic development visible — not to create pressure, not to rank kids, but to celebrate the truth that effort, over time, becomes progress.

ScorX covers 16 sports including AFL, basketball, netball, rugby union, rugby league, touch rugby, soccer, field hockey, volleyball, water polo, tennis, badminton, squash, racquetball, pickleball, and table tennis.

## Brand Positioning
ScorX is the sports tracking app that transforms match day into meaningful data so that every game counts toward a development story worth sharing.

Unlike professional analytics tools built for elite performance programs, ScorX is built for the sideline — simple enough for a parent to use in real time, powerful enough for a coach to act on.

## The Problem ScorX Solves
Community sport is full of effort and almost no evidence. Kids train twice a week, play every weekend, and at the end of a season most families couldn't tell you if their child actually improved — because no one was measuring anything. ScorX turns participation into progress you can see.

## Key Messages Per Audience
- **Parents:** "You've watched every game. Now you can prove every improvement."
- **Coaches:** "Stop coaching on gut feel. Start developing with proof."
- **Players:** "Your stats don't lie. Find out what's actually getting better."

## Pricing Tiers

### ScorX Basic — Free
Score tracking and game timer across all 16 sports. The introduction. Enough to see the value. Free forever, no credit card required.

### ScorX Athlete — $4.99/month or $49.99/year
**Core promise:** Track every game. Prove every improvement.

For the parent who shows up to every game and wants to be a meaningful part of their child's development — not just a spectator.

- **The Game Journal** — every game, every stat, automatically logged and stored. A permanent record of your child's sporting life.
- **The Progress Report** — AI-generated monthly summary showing what's improved, what to focus on, and how this season compares to last.
- **The Highlight Card** — shareable stat card generated after every game. Built for Instagram, made for proud parents.
- **The Athlete Timeline** — a visual journey through an athlete's career across every sport they play, all in one place.
- Multi-Sport Coverage — AFL, basketball, netball, rugby, hockey, touch, tennis and more.
- Up to 5 Players, iCloud Sync, CSV Data Export, 2-Year History, Family Sharing

30-day free trial. No credit card required.

### ScorX Team — $9.99/month or $99.99/year
**Core promise:** Develop every player. Retain every family.

For the community coach who wants to run a professional development program without a professional budget.

- **The Team Dashboard** — squad-wide view of performance patterns and development gaps.
- **Player Development Reports** — individual summaries you can share directly with families. The single most powerful retention tool in community sport.
- **The Coaching Edge** — AI-generated weekly training focus based on actual match data, not generic drills.
- **Distributed Recording** — invite parents to record stats for their own child. They get engagement. You get richer data.
- **Perception vs Reality Insights** — compare how players felt they performed against what the data shows.
- **Season Certificates** — auto-generated "Most Improved," "Top Performer," and custom achievement cards.
- 5 Teams, 150 Players, PDF & CSV Export

## The Distributed Recording Differentiator
Most stat-tracking apps require one person to do all the work. ScorX flips this. By inviting parents to record stats for their own child, ScorX turns a chore into a connection. Parents become invested contributors rather than passive spectators. The coach gets richer data. The parent gets a closer relationship with their child's game.

Copy angle: "ScorX doesn't just track your team. It brings your team's families into the development conversation."

## Key Facts
- Works completely offline — full functionality without internet connection
- Setup takes less than 2 minutes
- Tracks 100+ customisable statistical activities across 16 sports
- iCloud sync for family sharing across devices (ScorX Athlete and above)
- Privacy-first — no ads, no tracking, no third-party data sharing
- Sport-specific scoring rules for all 16 supported sports
- Real-time statistics updated during live games
- 30-day free trial of ScorX Athlete, no credit card required

### Team Sports

- Basketball

### Racquet Sports
- Tennis
- Badminton
- Squash
- Racquetball
- Pickleball
- Table Tennis

## What ScorX Is Not
- Not an elite performance platform (no professional scouting language)
- Not a surveillance tool (development and connection, not monitoring)
- Not gender-specific (girls, boys, all ages, all sports, all abilities)
- Not for professional clubs — ScorX serves the grassroots

## Technical Details
- Platform: iOS 18.0 or later
- Offline capability: Full functionality without internet
- Data portability: CSV export (ScorX Athlete); PDF export (ScorX Team)
- Family Sharing: Supported on ScorX Athlete and Team through iCloud
- Data retention: 2-year history on ScorX Athlete and above
- Privacy: No third-party data sharing, no advertisements, no analytics tracking
- App size: ~50 MB
